question: Fit a straight-line trend to monthly completed revenue from January 2024 to December 2025, using month number 1 to 24 as x. Which months fell more than 1.5 standard deviations below the trend line, using the standard deviation of the residuals, and what was each month's residual (actual minus trend, in dollars)? Label months as YYYY-MM.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7)), indexed_rev AS (SELECT month, rev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS x FROM monthly_rev), stats AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(x) AS sum_x, SUM(rev) AS sum_y, SUM(x * x) AS sum_xx, SUM(x * rev) AS sum_xy FROM indexed_rev), regression AS (SELECT n, sum_x, sum_y, sum_xx, sum_xy, (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x) AS slope, (sum_y - ((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_x) / (n * sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x)) * sum_x) / n AS intercept FROM stats), residuals AS (SELECT i.month, i.rev AS actual_revenue, (r.slope * i.x + r.intercept) AS trend_revenue, (i.rev - (r.slope * i.x + r.intercept)) AS residual FROM indexed_rev AS i CROSS JOIN regression AS r), sd_calc AS (SELECT SQRT(SUM(residual * residual) / (n - 2)) AS sd_res FROM residuals CROSS JOIN regression), with_sd AS (SELECT r.month, r.residual, s.sd_res FROM residuals AS r CROSS JOIN sd_calc AS s) SELECT month, residual FROM with_sd WHERE residual < -1.5 * sd_res ORDER BY residual ASC LIMIT 500
